description: This file contains a collection of utility functions, configuration synchronization routines, validation functions for various data types, and system interaction code for a diagnostics and configuration management component in a network device firmware. It includes functions for file operations, string manipulation, IP address processing, and interactions with system files and external services.

methods.name: pid_t get_pid(const char * pname)
methods.description: Retrieves the process ID of a process by name from the /proc filesystem.

methods.name: int compare_strings(const void * a,const void * b)
methods.description: Compares two strings, intended for sorting purposes.

methods.name: get_uptime
int check_file(const char * path)
methods.description: Checks the existence of a file or pattern using glob.

methods.name: char * cidr2netmask(int bits)
methods.description: Converts CIDR prefix length to dotted-decimal netmask string.

methods.name: netmask2cidr
methods.description: Converts dotted-decimal netmask string to CIDR prefix length.

methods.name: is_strword_in_optionvalue
methods.description: Checks if a word is contained within an option value string.

methods.name: remove_new_line
methods.description: Removes trailing newline character from a string.

methods.name: int dmcmd(const char * cmd,int n,...)
methods.description: Executes a command with waiting for its completion, returning the status.

methods.name: int dmcmd_no_wait(const char * cmd,int n,...)
methods.description: Starts a command asynchronously without waiting for completion.

methods.name: run_cmd
methods.description: Runs a command and captures its output in a buffer.

methods.name: hex_to_ip
methods.description: Converts a hex string representing an IP address to dotted-decimal format.

methods.name: char * diagnostics_get_option(const char * sec_name,const char * option)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific option value from diagnostics configuration.

methods.name: char * diagnostics_get_option_fallback_def(const char * sec_name,const char * option,const char * default_value)
methods.description: Retrieves an option value or returns a default if not set.

methods.name: void diagnostics_set_option(const char * sec_name,const char * option,const char * value)
methods.description: Sets a specific option value in diagnostics configuration.

methods.name: void diagnostics_reset_state(const char * sec_name)
methods.description: Resets the DiagnosticState option to 'None' if not already requested.

methods.name: char * diagnostics_get_interface_name(struct dmctx * ctx,const char * value)
methods.description: Extracts interface name from a device IP interface string.

methods.name: long download_file(char * file_path,const char * url,const char * username,const char * password)
methods.description: Downloads a file from a URL, either via local copy or HTTP using libcurl.

methods.name: upload_file
methods.description: Uploads a file to a URL, either via local copy or HTTP using libcurl.

methods.name: int get_proto_type(const char * proto)
methods.description: Returns a protocol type enum based on a string input.

methods.name: is_str_eq
methods.description: Checks if two strings are equal.
